'''Berrig''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A member of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]], he was stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TOR" />
